risks_and_mitigations:
Act 1 may feel cold, with banter coming from faceless shapes. Mitigation:
- Build the 60 s Act 1 test (arrivals plus 'Sit down, Scott') before committing the masters.
- Comic timing comes from the twos cadence, Scott's tidy corrections, Angelo's cigarette business, Christof's marquee, Kay's lingering lipstick glyph, and the profile micro-acting set (brow, jaw, smile notch, tilt, breath).
- Act 1 average shot lengths are protected from compression.

Telling speakers apart in group silhouettes. Mitigation: four redundant cues per speaker (typeface, colour from their object, an entrance behaviour, a landing sound), plus placement next to the speaker. A silhouette lineup must pass at 120 px.
Uncanny graphic eyes. Mitigation: exactly 8 named uses (E0 to E7), each tested in the Act 1 cut. Any that fail revert to profile micro-acting with a rim-width change.

Hands carry the film. Mitigation: the largest asset budget goes to an 18-pose Bezier hand library authored at 4x, plus the three-pose Extra family. The hand-circle top-down is one bespoke hand-tuned composition, not a general IK solve.

Determinism breaks if springs or particles carry state between frames. Mitigation: all secondary motion is closed-form (a sum of decaying cosines from keyed steps); particles are closed-form functions of their spawn hash; Math.random, Date and performance.now are banned by a lint rule; a CI check renders 20 random frames twice and byte-compares them.
Path2D has no vertex access. Mitigation: all geometry is stored as Bezier point arrays and flattened to 6 px segments every frame before edge noise, rims and shadows are applied.

Canvas 2D has no threshold operation for halation, and blur is expensive. Mitigation: a dedicated quarter-res emissive buffer, blurred and screened; static layers are cached as ImageBitmap per shot. Expect 0.12-0.3 s per frame headless, about 40-100 minutes per export.

Fonts can silently fall back. Mitigation: load every face through the Google Fonts css2 link, then await document.fonts.load for each family/weight/stretch combination and assert document.fonts.check before frame 0. Every glyph used (em dash, curly quotes, apostrophe) is verified per face. Roboto Flex is registered with a stretch range so ctx.fontStretch keywords map to its width axis (Chromium 99 or later). If fontStretch is unavailable, Scott's width notches fall back to letterSpacing of 0 / -0.02 / -0.04 / -0.06 em.

Readability at speed with no voice actors. Mitigation:
- The hold rule max(0.9 s, 0.35 s + 55 ms per character).
- At most 3 lines on screen.
- Dialogue that persists across cuts wherever the average shot is under 2.5 s.
- A WCAG contrast of 4.5 or more, with an automatic ink knock-behind.
- A 44 px minimum.
- A type-only animatic watched at full speed before any art.

Type space inside the 2.20-2.76 letterbox. Mitigation: from 2.39 onward dialogue lives on the matte bands (138-192 px tall). A layout lint fails any glyph that touches the live/matte boundary. The Dispatcher band and the 160 px 'Me.'/'Two.' are reserved in the full-frame yard.

Runtime creep with about 140 shots. Mitigation: 14 masters reused for about 85% of shots, and the runtime locked at 13:44 +/-20 s by the animatic. Act 1 stays at 4-4.5 s average shot length; any trims come from Act 2 cutaways, never from comic beats.

Over-signalling would spoil the mystery. Mitigation:
- No matte step at Kay's click.
- The tally records the characters' beliefs, not the truth.
- The handprint has no flicker callout.
- The hand ladder stays a second-viewing echo.
- No on-screen labels ever explain the Extra.

Violence reading as gratuitous, or ambiguous to the point of not landing. Mitigation:
- The oven leads with the projected ceiling shadow, then an 18-frame insert with the rig folded past its joint limits and bulb-rim separation of curls, knee and palm.
- Deena's cut is a short front-of-throat arc, never a full-width line (which would read as decapitation), ember then blood within 8 frames, first view under 1 s.
- Blood is always darker than the wine.

Photosensitive viewers, since the MP4 will be shared. Mitigation:
- A per-frame luminance and red-flash linter on quarter-res frames enforces at most 3 flashes per second in any window.
- The explosion is a single dark-to-bright transition: the inversion's mean luminance is held within 20% of blast-white, and the fire ramps down over 12 frames.
- Wine flashes are darkening multiplies, used only 3 times and at least 1 s from any other flash.
- The camera flash has a 6-frame decay.
- Strobe bars cover at most 20% of the screen at 0.8 Hz per colour.

Palette drifting into generic dark-plus-orange. Mitigation: at most 4 colours per shot (excluding ink, soot and type). Tungsten bands, card blue, rain silver, hood yellow and wine do visible work in every interior. Ember appears ONLY through knockouts and real fire, so it keeps its meaning.

The cold-open loop is an interpretation. The timer reading 00:01:37 in the cold open (later than 'Two.' at 00:00:54) implies the opening happens after 'Two.' This needs clearance with Osita Miles. Fallback: hide the timer digits in the cold open (band text only) and keep the 6% warm flicker at the cropped hand.
Audio memory: a single 14-minute OfflineAudioContext is about 320 MB. Mitigation: render per scene with 50 ms equal-power crossfades, from the same cue table as render(t).

The Extra leaking a positive shape. Mitigation: a review pass with the Extra layer isolated (every knockout and every PRESS-hand frame flagged). Any frame giving it an outline, an eye or a shadow is a blocking bug.
